name: Promises
crisisLine: In crisis right now? Someone answers every call.
locationLine: Along the main Eldoret–Bungoma Highway, next to Lake Energy Petrol Station, off Milo Road — just after Half London.
footerBlurb: We are committed to eradicating the stigma of addiction and fostering a sustainable culture of recovery.
admissionsNote: Admission is open to all suitable clients, irrespective of race, ethnicity, gender, culture, ideology, beliefs, sexual orientation, language or HIV status.
whatsappMessage: Hello, I would like to speak with someone at Promises Treatment Centre.
